title: Claude Crab
tagline: A pixel crab in VS Code that mirrors what Claude Code is doing
summary: A small VS Code extension that draws an animated pixel-art crab in a panel and changes its pose to match whatever the Claude Code assistant is doing right now: reading, writing, running a command, or finishing with a grin or a frown. Claude Code is wired to it by hooks, which post each event as JSON to a tiny local web server inside the extension, and every frame of the crab is drawn square by square in code on a 36 by 36 grid rather than loaded from image files.
